title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Palpitation
intro: Herbal creams for palpitation are topical creams or ointments that are made from natural herbs and are used to treat palpitations, which are irregular or rapid heartbeats. These creams are beneficial as they provide relief from palpitations due to their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and calming properties, which help to soothe the heart and nervous system. Examples of herbal creams that can be used to treat palpitations include aloe vera cream, which helps to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation, chamomile cream, which has a calming effect on the nervous system, and passionflower cream, which helps to reduce anxiety and promote a sense of calm. Additionally, other herbs such as valerian root, lavender, and peppermint can also be used in herbal creams to treat palpitations due to their sedative and calming effects.
